cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

mechanism: A controls the quiz format and declines a generic caption until B demonstrates memory of their shared words.
confusable: D81 preserving a pleasant caption is insufficient; D83 requires testing specific recall rather than generic sentiment.
comparison: Holiday phrase recall with options differs from tea preference tested after a label-assisted answer.
seedUse: Retain D83-b partial sentence then multiple-choice concession as an examiner approving only memory-testing routes.
